page.layout: Two engraved coin portraits side by side at the top (left: Tacitus, right: Florianus), each with a circular legend in the engraving. Below them, one column of running text in two paragraphs. A decorative ornament at the foot. No notes in the margins.

main_text.l: AN. TACITUS post Aurelianum imperauit anno à
mundo condito 4238. à Christo nato 276. Siquidem Aure-
ad Senatum,Senatus ad milites Imperatoris eligendi præroga-
tiuam deferebant. Tandem Senatus hunc Senatorij ordinis
Augustum dixit. Quàm verò amplissimi ordinis iudiciū à mi-
litari tumultu distet,Taciti electio ostendit,cùm in curia testa-
tum sit,neminem aut iustius quàm grauem virum,aut prudêtius quàm
doctū imperare posse. Verùm hic tantus vir sexto imperij sui mese
obiit. Vide Orof.lib.7.cap.24.Hic ducentesimo Imperij die, ut
inquit Aurelius Victor, apud Tarsum febre periit: at 6. mense
postquâ imperare cœperat, militari scelere periisse scribit Bap.
FLORIANUS,Taciti frater,cùm suo iudicio ad tantam
velut hæreditatem mortuo fratre properaret,Imperium & in-
vasit,& arripuit. Itaque cùm vix duobus mensibus præfuisset,
quasi per ludum Imperio usus,& ad ludibriū fortunæ eueētus[?]
esset,à militibus occisus est, aut ad Probi imperantis nuntium,
solutis sibi venis,expirauit.Consulito autores quos supra.

page.notes: Two coin engravings at the top: left, Tacitus (laureate/radiate bust facing right); right, Florianus (bearded bust facing right). The circular legends belong to the engravings and are not transcribed. The bottom ornament is a decorative vignette with no text. "mese" (sexto imperij sui mese) is printed as such; probably intended "mense", left as printed. "eueētus" is uncertain: the tilde over the e is hard to read; marked [?]. Long s rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised per rule (e.g. TACITUS, UNUM-style capitals).
